source: plan/bearings.md § Group-buy hero art — colorful SVGs (locked 2026-05-10 via /oversight)
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of productKind keycap-set
subject: Four CYL-profile keycaps in a staggered 2x2 cluster. The two INNER caps (back-right, front-left) carry the full coral-orange splash fill plus a small abstracted Katakana-style accent glyph (three strokes, not a literal character). The two OUTER caps (back-left, front-right) carry the set's other two body colours: an unbleached beige (back-left) and a muted industrial grey (front-right), together reading as the orange/beige/gray GMK CYL Orange Alert palette. Bronze theme dot at upper-right margin.
focal_caps: back-right and front-left (the two inner/center caps) — full coral-orange splash, each with an abstracted Katakana-style accent glyph
hue_safety_note: GH #928 flagged prior hero-art drift into stock blue/cyan hues (~195-265). No hue in this file falls in that range; all accents sit in the warm 28/75/85/90 band.
heroImageAlt_recommended: Four CYL-profile keycaps in a cluster, warm-grey line strokes with a coral-orange wash across two center alpha caps and small abstracted Katakana-style accent glyphs, evoking GMK CYL Orange Alert's industrial orange-beige-gray palette
heroImageAlt_deviation_from_brief: Brief-suggested alt text said 'warm-bronze line strokes' — the actual line stroke used across the family (and this file) is warm-grey (oklch(0.78 0.005 90)); warm-bronze (oklch(0.80 0.135 75)) is reserved for the fixed theme dot only, per every sibling file's convention (see divinikey-gmk-cyl-just-beachy.svg.json, kbdfans-gmk-cyl-prussian-alert.svg.json). heroImageAlt_recommended corrects this word to 'warm-grey' to match what was actually rendered.
warnings: heroImageAlt text supplied in the brief does not match the rendered stroke color family convention — see heroImageAlt_deviation_from_brief. Recommend using heroImageAlt_recommended in the data record instead of the brief's literal text.
